note: Paste each platform's own review widget code into its "html" field (as one JSON string; escape double quotes as \"). A filled platform shows its real reviews through the platform's widget and its short summary cards are dropped. The widget code loads only after a visitor accepts cookies or presses 'Show reviews'. Leave "html" empty to keep the summary cards. Never put API keys or secrets in this file.

google.how: Google has no official embed. Use a Google-reviews widget service connected to the Business Profile, or the Places API through a small server.

yelp.how: On yelp.com open the review, choose the three-dot menu, then 'Embed review', and paste the code. Repeat for each review you want to show.

zillow.how: Zillow Reviews widget (zillow.com/webtools/widgets/review-widget/) or the Lender Reviews API; sign in as the lender.

bbb.how: BBB Dynamic Seal, generated from the BBB business account. It shows the seal and rating and links to the BBB profile; it does not show review text.
